transcribed_question:
IDENTIFY THIS SPECIMEN
STRUCTURE A CULAI WITH FADED BLUE

marker.description: Faded blue paint marking the greater cornu of the hyoid bone

main_explanation: The specimen is an isolated hyoid bone, a U-shaped bone in the neck that supports the tongue and provides attachment for muscles of the floor of the mouth and larynx.

supporting_question.question: Which of the following is a unique characteristic of the hyoid bone?
options: It articulates directly with the mandible
It is the only bone in the body that does not articulate with another bone
It is part of the axial skeleton
supporting_question.explanation: The hyoid bone is unique because it does not articulate with any other bone; it is suspended in the neck by muscles and ligaments.
